## Activity

During December 2024, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 410 captures as part of its routine eye screening activity. The service maintained its planned capture activity across the reporting period. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with no other operational interruption recorded in the report.

The capture total provides the activity baseline for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. Results below are presented against this activity level to support local monitoring and follow-up.

## Image quality

A total of 23 captures were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.6 of all captures. The result should be reviewed alongside local image acquisition practice and used to identify any opportunities to improve the consistency of photographs obtained at the clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 109 referable results during December 2024. The median lag from capture to completed grading was 13 days. This provides the main measure of timeliness for the reporting period and should be considered when reviewing referral communication and follow-up arrangements.
